data.heading: Summary and key points
data.text:
This fictional workshop turns a square sheet into a small paper lantern.

## Key points

- [▶ 0:00](?t=0#episode-video) Begin with a square so the edges line up.
- [▶ 1:30](?t=90#episode-video) Fold the base before joining the sides.
- [▶ 3:00](?t=180#episode-video) Compare the panels before the final join.

## Fold comparison

| Fold | Purpose | Check |

| Base crease | Support the shape | Edges align |
| Panel crease | Join the sides | Tabs overlap evenly |
